title: WARRANT controller rules
description: Controller decision table (04 section 4). Rules are ordered: the first matching rule wins, so the JSON array order is significant.

rules.description: Ordered decision rules; the first rule whose `when` matches produces the action.

id.description: Rule id, unique within the table.

when.description: Controller inputs that must match. An empty object always matches. Values are booleans, enum strings or comparisons such as `>0`.

^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$.description: Expected value of one controller input.

action.description: Action the controller returns when the rule matches.

next.description: Operation the agent should run next, for example `clarify` or `verify`.
